sources.title: GitHub - lbcb-sci/RiNALMo: RiboNucleic Acid (RNA) Language Model
sources.snippet: Motivated by the successes of protein language models, we introduce RiboNucleic Acid Language Model (RiNALMo) to help unveil the hidden code of RNA. RiNALMo is the largest RNA language model to date with 650 million parameters pre-trained on 36 million non-coding RNA sequences from several available databases.
